probe_unsandboxed_reason: A version, update, model or doctor probe of agy reads its sign-in and writes its state and its own install under $HOME. The phase sandbox grants no write outside the cell, so the probe runs outside it.

interactive_prompts.name: auth_recheck
interactive_prompts.regex: Authentication required|Please log in|Sign in to (Antigravity|Google|Gemini)|Login expired
interactive_prompts.note: Bridge cannot complete OAuth/Google login; escalate to operator

interactive_prompts.name: quota_exhausted
interactive_prompts.note: Distinguishable from transient rate-limit; usually requires plan upgrade

interactive_prompts.name: permission_prompt
interactive_prompts.note: Belt-and-suspenders alongside --dangerously-skip-permissions; harmless if bypass already accepted it

note: agy is Antigravity, Gemini-backed (NOT Anthropic). agy 1.5.17 headless takes --model and --effort: model_tier and effort are channel=flag and the values come from the route. -m is undefined ('flags provided but not defined: -m'; docs/incidents/cycle-154-agy-tmux-m-flag-repl-boot-timeout.md). This headless manifest declares NO model_tier_map of its own: model_tier_map_from points at the agy FAMILY table (agy-tmux.json) and LoadManifest adopts it. Cost-leak guards: GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY.
